name: How long does a mold inspection take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a mold inspection take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a mold inspection depends on the size of your property and the complexity of the suspected mold issue. A typical residential inspection for a standard-sized home might take 1 to 3 hours. Larger properties or situations requiring extensive moisture mapping and multiple sample collections will naturally take longer. The inspector will provide an estimated timeframe before beginning the assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A mold inspection usually takes 1 to 3 hours, depending on property size and issue complexity.
